name: Varnam Sarees & Textiles
tagline: Silk and cotton sarees, direct from the loom
about:
Varnam Sarees & Textiles is a demo catalog built by OneCatalog to show how a saree and textile shop looks. The shop, address and prices are examples.
WhatsApp enquiries from this demo go to OneCatalog.
metaHeadline: Kanchipuram Silk, Cotton and Silk Cotton Sarees
metaDescription: Varnam Sarees & Textiles demo catalog. Kanchipuram silk sarees, soft silk, handloom cotton, silk cotton, pattu pavadai and silk dhotis with prices.
